scripts.start: npm run pm2-check && pm2 delete api 2>/dev/null; pm2 start "bun -b --hot --experimental-http2-fetch --experimental-http3-fetch --tls-max-v1.3 ." --name api -i 1 && pm2 save --force
scripts.start-4: npm run pm2-check && pm2 delete api 2>/dev/null; pm2 start "bun -b --hot --experimental-http2-fetch --experimental-http3-fetch --tls-max-v1.3 --dns-result-order=ipv4first ." --name api -i 1 && pm2 save --force
scripts.start-6: npm run pm2-check && pm2 delete api 2>/dev/null; pm2 start "bun -b --hot --experimental-http2-fetch --experimental-http3-fetch --tls-max-v1.3 --dns-result-order=ipv6first ." --name api -i 1 && pm2 save --force
scripts.stop: npm run pm2-check && pm2 delete api 2>/dev/null && pm2 save --force
scripts.browser-install: python3 -m venv .venv && ./.venv/bin/pip install "scrapling[ai]" && ./.venv/bin/python -m playwright install chromium
scripts.win-browser-install: py -m venv .venv && .venv/Scripts/pip install "scrapling[ai]" && .venv/Scripts/python -m playwright install chromium
scripts.gen-update: bun run stop; git fetch origin && git reset --hard origin/main && git clean -fd; bun install; bun run gen; npm run pm2-check; bun run start; npm update -g
scripts.soft-update: git fetch origin && git reset --hard origin/main && git clean -fd && bun run gen; npm run pm2-check; npm update -g
